title: Monkey Dash 3D
description: Sprint through lush jungle bridges and temple ruins as a nimble monkey—vault over rolling logs, scoop up golden bananas, and dash through speed rings.
controls: Swipe to change lanes, leap across gaps, and collect golden bananas along the jungle track.

zh-CN.title: 猴子快跑 3D
zh-CN.description: 动感丛林 3D 猴子快跑：化身机灵小猴在热带雨林与神庙赛道极速狂奔，腾空跃过滚木狂收香蕉冲刺高分！
zh-CN.controls: 滑动屏幕左右变道并起跳越过障碍，收集沿途金香蕉挑战极限跑酷纪录。
